log.title: Sworn in as President
log.body: Golden Fixture takes the oath of office. Review the budget and your cabinet: the nation is watching your first decisions.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions
log.body: Intermediaries suggest that a quiet round of talks with the most hostile neighbour might lower the temperature.

log.title: Oruvan Union agents probe your defences
log.body: Foreign agents mapped sensitive sites before they were noticed. Readiness suffers while the leaks are plugged. Counter-intelligence reduces the risk.

log.title: Bridge collapse in the South
log.body: A newly built bridge in the South collapsed within a year of opening. Locals allege that cement and steel were skimped on.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

log.title: A friendly country wants to buy Indian equipment
log.body: A buyer from abroad has requested a batch of surplus equipment. The deal would bring in cash.

log.title: Intelligence foils a plot by Shadow Meridian
log.body: Agents uncovered Shadow Meridian preparing an attack in the East. The cell was rolled up before it could act.

log.title: Hostile hackers probe defence networks
log.body: Cyber teams detect an intrusion into logistics systems. The origin is hidden behind several countries.

log.title: Bridge collapse in the South: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. An inquiry is ordered. Locals do not expect much.

log.title: A friendly country wants to buy Indian equipment: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline. The forces appreciate it.

log.title: Quarterly cabinet report
log.body: Best run: Industry & Infra (104% efficiency). Weakest: Disaster Mgmt (74%).

log.body: Oruvani patrol boats have detained a group of Indian fishing crews in disputed waters. Families are appealing to the government.

log.title: Invitation for a state visit: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline and stay home.

log.title: Disinformation campaign
log.body: A flood of fake videos and forwarded messages is stoking panic and distrust online.

log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline. The idea quietly dies.

log.body: A routine check-up shows signs of overwork. Your physician urges you to slow down for a few days.

log.body: Villagers in the North-East are blocking surveyors from a planned industrial corridor, saying compensation is far too low.

log.body: The government closed 2026 with a deficit of ₹8,34,647 crore. Growth 6.3%, inflation 4.1%, unemployment 7.5%, debt 52.6% of GDP. Approval stands at 34.1%.
